name: Taming the Monsters
source:
Nurse Emberly is welcomed to the prison by the intimidating Iron Warden, who gives her a warning. She then meets a group of monsters, all of whom she befriends – and all of them are hot.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
安伯莉护士来到监狱，受到了令人生畏的铁狱监狱长的欢迎，铁狱监狱长向她发出了警告。然后她遇到了一群怪物，她和他们都成了朋友——而且他们都很性感。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
